text.content:
The university, the port, and South Night City in all but name.

Region: Heywood (district J). Was: the University District, South Night City, the Port of Night City
Controlled by: NCU Security on campus; Precinct 1 by day; south of Skyline South after dark, the Valentinos' corners and the Animals' gyms
The feel of it: Middle-class waterfront in the north, older and worse the further south you walk
Notable locations: Night City University, Bulwark (#35), the Water Treatment Plant (#36), Biotechnica Campus (#37), Kosmos Hospital (#62), NC Symphony Hall (#63), MAX-TAC HQ (#64), Savage Docs (#65), the Slammer (#66), Medical Technologies (#67), the Port
Danger: Moderate / Combat; the south end is Combat after dark. SC 6 (NCPD Precinct 1 and NCU Security, Hardened Medium). UC 4

Night City University anchors the north end, and the Bulwark waterfront is about as middle class as Night City gets. Students and professors live around NCU, dock workers and sailors near the port, families in H2 over Bulwark, and the poor of South Night City below Skyline South. MaxTac works out of Wellsprings, which keeps the cyberpsychos polite.

Places

  • Night City University. SC 8: NCU Security. The "academic fortress": research labs, corporate chairs, and a library of paper books. Tuition costs more than a car.
  • Bulwark (#35). SC 7. A waterfront mall, a boardwalk, and real fish at insane prices.
  • Water Treatment Plant (#36). SC 8. Most of the city's drinking water comes through here.
  • Biotechnica Campus (#37). SC 10. One of its labs files patents on 2010s research nobody can find.
  • Kosmos Hospital (#62). SC 7. Public: long waits, good surgeons, no questions about payment until after.
  • NC Symphony Hall (#63). SC 7. The Philharmonic Vampyres' tags are still on the stage door.
  • MAX-TAC HQ (#64). SC 10. Psycho Squad's home.
  • Savage Docs (#65). SC 4. Back-alley ripperdocs. Clean needles, mostly.
  • The Slammer (#66). SC 3. A bar in a decommissioned holding facility; the cells are booths, and the Animals fight every Friday.
  • Medical Technologies (#67). SC 8. Clinics, cryotanks and a Cryobank (150eb a month).
  • Port of Night City. SC 6. The Free Port: no customs to speak of.

Getting There

NCART: University, Bulwark, Port of Night City, Parque del Mar (Northern, Southern Lines).

Turf

Valentinos (south), the Animals (gyms).

People

  • Commander Lorenzo "Contender" Lawrence (Solo 9, MaxTac).
  • Stop Sign (Solo 7, MaxTac).
  • Professor Lionel Hask (Netrunner 6). NCU's head of Net Studies; NetWatch audits his seminar on the Purge every term.
  • Alpha Tusk (Ganger 7, Animals). Runs the Slammer's fight nights.
  • "Saint" Teo Vargas (Medtech 5). Savage Docs' best surgeon; the Valentinos pay for half his work.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.10
